question: Estimate the operating cost of running a Delhi Metro line annually.
idealClarificationQuestions: Single metro line (e.g., Yellow Line or Blue Line) annual O&M cost? Yes.
Excludes capital cost / debt servicing (those are separate)? Yes — operating only.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Single line characteristics: ~50 km, ~40 stations, ~300 train trips/day.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Other (insurance, R&M of buildings, contingency): ~₹35 Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~₹600 Cr annual operating cost per Delhi Metro line.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Total operating cost per line per year

calculationFlow: - Power (electricity for trains): ~₹220 Cr/year (single biggest cost; 35-40% of O&M).
- IT systems + AFC (Automated Fare Collection): ~₹15 Cr.
- Other (insurance, R&M of buildings, contingency): ~₹35 Cr.
Total operating cost per line per year: ~₹590-620 Cr.
Round: ~₹600 Cr annual operating cost per Delhi Metro line.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: ~₹600 Cr annual operating cost per Delhi Metro line.
